description: Header file defining the WebSocketBasicStream class and related components for handling non-multiplexed WebSocket connections, including buffer management, adapter interface, and stream operations.

classes.name: WebSocketBasicStream
classes.description: Implements WebSocketStream for non-multiplexed ws:// connections, managing reading, writing, and connection lifecycle.

classes.name: BufferSizeManager
classes.description: Manages adaptive buffer sizing based on read timing and throughput.

classes.name: Adapter
classes.description: Abstract interface for socket connection, supporting read, write, disconnect, and initialization check.

methods.name: WebSocketBasicStream
methods.description: Constructor initializing the WebSocket stream with connection, buffers, protocol, extensions, and logging.

methods.name: CreateWebSocketBasicStreamForTesting
methods.description: Creates a WebSocketBasicStream instance for testing purposes.

methods.name: ReadEverything
methods.description: Reads data until completion or error.

methods.name: OnReadComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of a read operation.

methods.name: WriteEverything
methods.description: Writes data until fully drained or error.

methods.name: OnWriteComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of a write operation.

methods.name: HandleReadResult
methods.description: Parses read data as WebSocket frames.

methods.name: ConvertChunksToFrames
methods.description: Converts frame chunks into WebSocket frames.

methods.name: ConvertChunkToFrame
methods.description: Converts a chunk into a WebSocket frame.

methods.name: CreateFrame
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket frame from data and header info.

methods.name: AddToIncompleteControlFrameBody
methods.description: Appends data to partial control frame body.
